_purpose: Machine-readable quarantine list for patch scripts that can never apply to the current tree. Rationale: applier-doctor measured 59 scripts/*patch*.py on 2026-09-29 -> 38 already-applied, 14 stale-anchor, 6 error, 1 landed. The 20 non-applying scripts are re-executed on every applier run, producing permanent noise and masking genuinely new drift. Quarantining them makes the applier signal-only.
_policy: Quarantine is NOT deletion. Each entry is retained with its measured evidence. A script may only leave quarantine when an owner re-anchors it against the current tree or explicitly retires it.
_classification_pending: This manifest deliberately does NOT classify entries as obsolete vs still-needed. That distinction requires per-script owner review and cannot be inferred from an anchor miss alone: an anchor miss can mean (a) the target code moved on (obsolete) or (b) the fix is still needed but the tree drifted (live defect). Guessing would hide real defects.
